name: Amber Table Works
description: Tables specialist. Upscale showroom: better finishes, prices somewhat above the market. We carry desks, dining tables, nightstands.
skill_description: We sell desks, dining tables, nightstands, and nothing else. Describe the piece you need in your own words (use, size, material, capacity) and we offer a matching item from our range with a price. Then send your offer as a number; we answer with a counteroffer or close the sale with a receipt.
